text: MHN(\(\alpha\), \(\beta\), \(\gamma\)) distribution support \((0, \infty)\) density \[f(x \mid \alpha, \beta, \gamma) \;\propto\;   x^{\alpha - 1} \exp(-\beta x^2 + \gamma x), \qquad x > 0,\] \(\alpha, \beta > 0\) \(\gamma \\mathbb{R}\). arises full conditional Bayesian MCMC samplers range models (Sun et al. 2023, Section 2; Gao & Wang 2025, Section 1): example, extra scalar sandwich algorithm binary regression \(t\) link, latent radius projected normal distribution, concentration parameter von Mises-Fisher distribution, latent scales robust Bayesian graphical models, shrinkage priors Bayesian elastic net. also generalises number familiar one-sided distributions: package implements efficient samplers Sun, Kong & Pal (2023) (Algorithms 1 / 3) Gao & Wang (2025) Relaxed Transformed Density Rejection (RTDR) method, whose acceptance Gao & Wang bound 1/e contact points lie band (see ?rmhn), dispatches automatically.
